exposure: social support (measured by Social Support Rating Scale - SSRS)
outcome: postpartum post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) (measured by Perinatal Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder Questionnaire - PPQ)
cohort: Eligible mothers who delivered at a tertiary hospital in Guangdong province of China between November 2022 and April 2023.
finding: Social support, including subjective, objective, support availability, and overall scores, was inversely associated with postpartum PTSD scores, indicating a protective effect against PTSD.
